## Summary

Describe the portal or engineering outcome and important design choices.

## Originating issue

Closes #

## Validation

List every command and result, including blocked or unrun checks.

## Accessibility

Describe semantic, keyboard, focus, contrast, and responsive impact, or state
why the change has no accessibility impact.

## Documentation impact

State what was updated, what follow-up is needed, or why no update is needed.

## Known limitations

List deferred work, risks, screenshots or visual verification instructions,
and preview status.

- [ ] The approved scope is implemented without unrelated changes.
- [ ] No credentials or client data are included.
- [ ] Required validation passes.
- [ ] The pull request remains human-reviewed and unmerged.
